description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: chemical-thermodynamics

source.quote: The first law of thermodynamics is a formulation of the law of conservation of energy

facts.claim: G is minimised at equilibrium at constant T and P

source.quote: The Gibbs energy is the thermodynamic potential that is minimized when a system reaches chemical equilibrium at constant pressure and temperature
can be used to calculate the maximum amount of work, other than pressure–volume work

facts.claim: Z = actual molar volume / ideal molar volume (deviation from ideal gas)

source.quote: describes the deviation of a real gas from ideal gas behaviour

facts.claim: Deviation grows at high pressure and low temperature

source.quote: the lower the temperature or the larger the pressure

facts.claim: Fugacity is an effective (corrected) pressure for a real gas

source.quote: the fugacity of a real gas is an effective partial pressure which replaces the ideal partial pressure

facts.claim: Partial molar property = ∂(extensive property)/∂n_i at constant T, P
facts.pattern: partial derivative|∂[^.]{0,20}∂\s*n|with respect to (the )?(amount|moles|number of moles)

source.quote: It is the partial derivative of the extensive property with respect to the amount (number of moles) of the component of interest

facts.claim: Activity coefficient corrects for non-ideal mixtures

source.quote: an activity coefficient is a factor used to account for deviation of a mixture of chemical substances from ideal behaviour

facts.claim: γ > 1 positive and γ < 1 negative deviation from Raoult's law

source.quote: substance B shows positive and negative deviation from Raoult's law

facts.claim: Margules model for excess Gibbs energy of liquid mixtures

source.quote: The Margules activity model is a simple thermodynamic model for the excess Gibbs free energy of a liquid mixture
modern models like NRTL and Wilson cannot

facts.claim: Gibbs phase rule governs multi-phase equilibrium (F = C − P + 2)

source.quote: the phase rule is a general principle governing multi-component, multi-phase systems in thermodynamic equilibrium

facts.claim: Flash: pressure reduction partly vaporises a saturated liquid

source.quote: Flash evaporation (or partial evaporation) is the partial vapor that occurs when a saturated liquid stream undergoes a reduction in pressure

facts.claim: At an azeotrope the vapour has the same composition as the liquid

source.quote: when an azeotrope is boiled, the vapour has the same proportions of constituents as the unboiled mixture

facts.claim: Minimum- and maximum-boiling (positive and negative) azeotropes

source.quote: The boiling point of an azeotrope is either less than the boiling point temperatures of any of its constituents (a positive azeotrope)

facts.claim: LLE: two immiscible liquid phases share a solute

source.quote: In solvent extraction, two immiscible liquids are shaken together

facts.claim: K does not depend on initial concentrations

source.quote: the equilibrium constant is independent of the initial analytical concentrations

facts.claim: van 't Hoff: ln K changes with T according to ΔH°

source.quote: The Van 't Hoff equation relates the change in the equilibrium constant, Keq, of a chemical reaction to the change in temperature
